definitions.explanation: failing (an exam or grade); flunking; not passing

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{落第|らくだい}した。
{彼|かれ}は{落第|らくだい}して{一年|いちねん}{留年|りゅうねん}した。
examples.english: He failed and had to repeat a year.

examples.japanese: {運転免許|うんてんめんきょ}の{試験|しけん}で{落第|らくだい}しないよう{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: I studied hard so I wouldn't fail the driving test.

notes:
{落第|らくだい} refers to failing an examination or not meeting requirements to advance to the next grade level.

Common expressions:
- {落第|らくだい}する (to fail)
- {落第点|らくだいてん} (failing grade)
- {落第生|らくだいせい} (student who failed)

Antonym:
- {合格|ごうかく} (passing, success)

Figurative usage:
{落第|らくだい} can be used figuratively to describe not meeting standards in non-academic contexts:
- {親|おや}として{落第|らくだい}だ (I'm a failure as a parent)
